usedFor: Expensya captures spend, and “Add Receipt” and “Add Expense” put items into it from other events.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking Created” in Recras, then “Add Receipt” in Expensya
bestTemplate.why: A booking can mean a cost, so a receipt lands in Expensya without retyping.

watchOut: “Add Expense” writes to your spend records, so test with one event before a busy trigger fills them.
